paragraph: In July 2026 [AFR-IX Telecom was deploying into Raxio's data centre in Luanda](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/07/23/raxio-and-afr-ix-partner-to-boost-digital-connectivity-in-angola-and-mozambique/>). Raxio says it is Tier III certified. [Paratus Group says its two Luanda data centres are Tier III by design](<https://paratus.africa/blog/paratus-group-secures-funding-for-infrastructure-expansion-projects/>). [Paratus Angola opened the second in 2019](<https://www.datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/paratus-group-to-build-third-angola-data-center/>). In the last twelve months, [the government inaugurated its National Data Centre and Cloud at Camama on 28 April 2026](<https://www.menosfios.com/data-centers-em-angola-quais-tem-certificacao-internacional/>). Menos Fios reported in May that its 12 modules are certified Tier III. No global cloud region has been found in the country. Mature would need a global cloud provider to sell its services from a cloud region in the country.

By 2020 [the World Bank reported that Burundi Backbone System has one level-3 data center](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/605991608528899689/pdf/Burundi-Digital-Economy-Assessment.pdf>), built at a cost of USD 2 million. The operator uses it to offer hosting to customers, and other public agencies use it to back up their systems. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found states that a data centre for hire in Burundi is Tier III or above, and no global cloud region has been found. Establishing would need one data centre for hire at Tier III or above.

In April 2026 [an ASIN official said Benin has several data centres, one of them run commercially by SBIN](<https://cio-mag.com/souverainete-et-cloud-le-benin-face-aux-enjeux-de-lhebergement-des-donnees/>). [MTN Benin rents servers and storage to businesses at its data centre](<https://www.mtn.bj/business/connectivite/data-center/>). In the last twelve months, [SBIN's Celtiis Business launched Celtiis Cloud in Cotonou on 31 July 2026](<https://cadreco.media/evenement/2026/afterwork-celtiis-business-celtiis-business-celebre-2-ans-de-croissance-et-devoile-celtiis-cloud>), selling hosting, storage, backup and colocation. No source found states that a data centre for hire in Benin is Tier III or above, and no global cloud region has been found. Establishing would need one data centre for hire at Tier III or above.

By 2025 [BTW Media described the Virtix data centre of Virtual Technologies & Solutions in Ouagadougou as Tier III](<https://btw.media/it-infrastructure/virtual-technologies-solutions-burkina-faso-connectivity-provider/>), with no certifying body named. It offers colocation, cloud and hosting services. In the last twelve months, [IKA Solution launched IKA Cloud in Ouagadougou on 31 July 2026](<https://lefaso.net/spip.php?article148312>), selling web hosting, dedicated servers and server colocation to outside customers. No second data centre for hire at Tier III or above has been found, and no global cloud region. Operating would need two or more data centres for hire at Tier III or above.

On 23 October 2025 [the Uptime Institute certified BoFiNet's Digital Delta Data Centre in Gaborone at Tier III as a constructed facility](<https://www.bofinet.co.bw/index.php/news/article/bofinets-digital-delta-data-centre-achieves-tier-iii-certification-from-uptime-institute>). [Mascom's chief executive says its Innovation Centre data centre is Tier III certified internationally](<https://businessweekly.co.bw/companies-markets/mascoms-strategic-shift-from-internal-need-to-market-opportunity>), without naming the certifier. He says it sells colocation, cloud, IaaS and disaster recovery to external customers. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No global cloud region has been found. Mature would need a global cloud provider to sell its services from a cloud region in the country.

In November 2023 [MainOne, an Equinix company, opened its expanded carrier-neutral AB1.2 data centre at VITIB, Grand Bassam](<https://mainone.africa-newsroom.com/press/mainone-an-equinix-company-expands-data-center-footprint-in-cote-divoire?lang=en>), which it says is built to Uptime Tier III standards. [Raxio says CIV1 is Uptime Institute Tier III certified](<https://www.raxiogroup.com/data-centres/cote-divoire/>) and [sells carrier-neutral colocation](<https://www.raxiogroup.com/raxio-tops-us380-million-in-committed-capital-as-roha-and-meridiam-boost-stakes-amid-sixfold-growth-surge-for-its-african-data-centres/>). In October 2025 [the digital ministry said ST Digital's new Grand-Bassam data centre was built to Tier III norms](<https://www.telecom.gouv.ci/new/index.php/actualite/148>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No global cloud region has been found. Mature would need a global cloud provider to sell its services from a cloud region in the country.

[Orange Business Cameroun describes its data centre, open since May 2017 with 340 racks in two white rooms, as Tier III+](<https://business.orange.cm/en/mieux-nous-connaitre.html>). In the last twelve months, [Camtel said in June 2026 that its Zamengoe data centre is certified Tier III by the Uptime Institute](<https://ecobiz54.info/telecoms-camtel-devoile-le-data-center-de-zamengoe-prouesse-de-souverainete-numerique-et-de-protection-des-donnees-au-cameroun/>). In June 2025 [ST Digital's chief executive had said Camtel's holds the Uptime Institute's Tier III design certificate](<https://www.digitalbusiness.africa/datacenters-certifies-ecosysteme-delaisse-le-paradoxe-de-la-gouvernance-numerique-au-cameroun/>). [In August 2026 Camtel presented its hosting services to institutions and businesses](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/08/14/camtel-showcases-zamengoe-data-center-to-plan-international-cameroon/>). No global cloud region has been found. Mature would need a global cloud provider to sell its services from a cloud region in the country.

[Communications Africa states that two Tier III data centres opened in Kinshasa in August 2024](<https://communicationsafrica.com/internet/drcs-largest-data-centre-opens>), Raxio DRC1 and OADC Texaf Digital. In October 2024 [DatacenterDynamics reported both as Uptime Institute Tier III certified](<https://www.datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/drc-bank-sofibanque-moves-to-oadc-data-center-in-kinshasa/>) and described the OADC Texaf site as a colocation facility. In the last twelve months this was cited and not changed: [in August 2026 Raxio described its DRC facility as Tier III certified and carrier-neutral](<https://www.raxiogroup.com/raxio-drc-to-host-kinshasa-internet-exchange-kinix-strengthening-national-connectivity/>). No global cloud region has been found. Mature would need a global cloud provider to sell its services from a cloud region in the country.

On 28 February 2024 the President [commissioned the regulator ARPCE's Tier 3+ data centre at Pointe-Noire](<https://gouvernement.cg/economie-numerique-denis-sassou-nguesso-connecte-le-congo-au-cable-2africa/>), which hosts data of the public administration and private firms. ARPCE [gives the Tier on its own word](<https://www.digitalbusiness.africa/congo-s-e-denis-sassou-nguesso-connecte-le-pays-au-cable-2-africa-le-datacenter-tier-3-de-larpce-inaugure/>), naming no certification. ST DIGITAL [says its centres in seven countries, Congo among them, are Tier 3 facilities](<https://st.digital/en/blog/st-digital-s-blog-1/st-digital-526>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No global cloud region has been found. Mature would need a global cloud provider to sell its services from a cloud region in the country.

By 2026 [Comores Cables states that its data centre offers secure, scalable data-management and hosting solutions to businesses of all sizes](<https://www.comorescables.km/Technologies>), with 99.9% availability and 10 Gbps of bandwidth. The same page says a separate neutral data centre is still under construction. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found states that a data centre for hire in the Comoros is Tier III or above, and no global cloud region has been found. Establishing would need one data centre for hire at Tier III or above.

[NOSi's 2024 accounts state that the Praia data centre holds Uptime Institute Tier III certification](<https://nosi.cv/documents/20121/3100977/Relat%C3%B3rio%20e%20Contas%20NOSi%20-%202024.pdf/2fe4a66a-1826-4951-4da3-9cce82aef26e>) and report revenue from housing and IaaS services. [NOSi, the state technology enterprise, operates secure data centres in Praia and Mindelo and offers cloud services to public and private entities](<https://www.caboverdeexpert.com/cabo-verde-digital-operational-nucleus-for-the-information-society-nosi/>). In the last twelve months, [NOSi launched a solar power system for the Praia data centre on 16 February 2026](<https://nosi.cv/pt/web/guest/w/lan%C3%A7amento-do-sistema-de-energia-fotovoltaico-do-data-center-da-praia>). No second data centre for hire at Tier III or above has been found, and no global cloud region. Operating would need two or more data centres for hire at Tier III or above.

In November 2024 [Wingu Africa launched its Tier 3 carrier-neutral data centre at the TO7 Technology Park](<https://africa.hyperscalers.news/news/wingu-africa-launches-tier-iii-data-center-in-djibouti/>), with a design capacity of 3 MW. [Djibouti Telecom describes its Djibouti Data Center as Tier 3, with colocation for customers](<https://international.djiboutitelecom.dj/>), and [the IFC says it has been in service since 2013](<https://www.ifc.org/en/insights-reports/2026/djibouti-private-sector-diagnostic>). In the last twelve months, [a World Bank diagnostic of September 2026 found the two main data centres nearly full](<https://www.agenceecofin.com/actualites-numerique/1711-143485-developpement-des-centres-de-donnees-ce-que-le-qatar-peut-apporter-a-djibouti>), Agence Ecofin reported. No global cloud region has been found. Mature would need a global cloud provider to sell its services from a cloud region in the country.

On 25 March 2025 [the Cerist national cloud platform opened in a data centre at Ben Aknoun](<https://www.jeune-independant.net/inauguration-dun-cloud-computing-au-cerist-vers-la-souverainete-numerique/>), selling hosting to public bodies, firms and researchers. [Iconsnet operates two data centres, in Algiers and Oran, offering cloud computing and off-site backup](<https://www.jeune-independant.net/centre-national-des-services-numeriques-le-coeur-digital-de-letat-prend-vie/>). In the last twelve months, [the Mohammadia complex of the national digital services centre was inaugurated on 5 July 2026](<https://www.jeune-independant.net/centre-national-des-services-numeriques-lalgerie-scelle-le-virage-vers-leconomie-2-0/>). Le Jeune Independant says it holds Tier III Design certification. A second data centre for hire at Tier III or above has not been found. Operating would need two or more data centres for hire at Tier III or above.

In December 2024 [Africa50 said Raya Data Center operates two Tier III data centres in Cairo](<https://www.africa50.com/media/news/article/africa50-announces-usd15-million-investment-in-raya-data-center/>). [Telecom Egypt's Regional Data Hub at Smart Village holds Uptime Institute Tier III certification of design, facility and operation](<https://te.eg/interactivemap/assets/downloads/Telecom_Egypt_The_Digital_Hub.pdf>). [Huawei announced it launched the Huawei Cloud Cairo Region on 21 May 2024](<https://www.huaweicloud.com/intl/en-us/news/20240523155312706.html>), its first public cloud region in North Africa. No change has been found in the last twelve months. [Commercial data centre capacity across Egypt stood at 28 MW in November 2026](<https://itmagazineme.com/egypt-allocates-440000-consultancy-budget-to-draft-national-data-centre-strategy/>).

By 2026 [Eritel Telecom Corporation's own service page offers paid Eritel Nextcloud private-cloud subscriptions](<https://eritel.com.er/contents.php?id=1046>) in Silver, Gold and Platinum tiers of 100 to 500 GB. Eritel says they are hosted in its own datacenters. An operator data centre in Eritrea is therefore selling hosting to outside customers. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found states that a data centre for hire in Eritrea is Tier III or above. Establishing would need one data centre for hire at Tier III or above.

In December 2024 [Raxio said it had gained the Uptime Institute's Tier III certificate for its Addis Ababa data centre](<https://clubofmozambique.com/news/raxio-groups-mozambique-and-ethiopia-data-centres-achieve-uptime-institute-tier-iii-facility-certification/>), a carrier-neutral colocation facility [opened in November 2023](<https://www.raxiogroup.com/raxio-continues-support-of-africas-digital-transformation-and-digital-economy-with-launch-of-new-flagship-data-centre-in-ethiopia/>). In April 2024 [Wingu Africa said its ICT Park data centre in Addis Ababa had met the criteria for the same certificate](<https://www.wingu.africa/latest-news/wingu-africa-achieves-tier-iii-certification-of-constructed-facility>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No global cloud region has been found. Mature would need a global cloud provider to sell its services from a cloud region in the country.

On 3 July 2026 [Gabon's first national data centre, run by ST Digital, opened at Nkok](<https://depeches241.com/?p=29457>), and it hosts the data of the state, firms and citizens. [TechAfrica News says it was built to Tier III international standards](<https://techafricanews.com/2026/07/06/gabon-inaugurates-first-tier-iii-datacenter-to-boost-digital-sovereignty/>). [The digital economy ministry calls it the Nkok Sovereign Tier III Datacenter](<https://agpgabon.ga/gabon-numerique-le-pays-sa-candidature-au-conseil-de-lunion-internationale-des-telecommunications/>). In the last twelve months, the Nkok opening is the only change found. A second data centre for hire at Tier III or above has not been found. Operating would need two or more data centres for hire at Tier III or above.

In June 2022 [Onix Accra 1 opened as Ghana's only Uptime-certified Tier IV data centre](<https://www.datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/ghanas-vice-president-opens-onix-tier-iv-data-center/>), and [Onix says it sells cross connects and a meet-me room to business customers](<https://onixdatacentres.com/home/infrastructure/>). In August 2024 [NITA, the state IT agency, said its certified Tier 3 data centre serves all public institutions and private businesses](<https://techfocus24.com/nita-gets-three-iso-certifications-at-a-go/>). In October 2025 [Digital Realty opened ACR2, a carrier-neutral data centre of 1.7 MW in Accra](<https://www.ecofinagency.com/news-digital/0411-50093-digital-realty-expands-african-footprint-with-new-data-center-in-ghana>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No global cloud region has been found. Mature would need a global cloud provider to sell its services from a cloud region in the country.

On 4 September 2025 Guinea launched [its national Data Center, run by COREX](<https://guineenews.org/2025/09/04/guinee-le-ministre-djiba-diakite-procede-au-double-lancement-du-point-gn-et-le-data-center-national-tier-lll/>). COREX's deputy director-general said it is certified Tier 3 Design by the Uptime Institute, with Tier 3 construction certification still to come. The presidency's chief of cabinet said it is open to offering hosting services. [GUILAB describes its operating data centre in Conakry as a colocation room serving telecom operators, ISPs and other customers](<https://guilab.com.gn/colsalisation/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. A second data centre for hire at Tier III or above has not been found. Operating would need two or more data centres for hire at Tier III or above.

On 26 August 2015 [the SIXP administrator listed as a challenge that no carrier-neutral data centres were available in The Gambia](<https://www.afpif.org/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/Gambia-IXP-Experience-.pdf>), citing high operating cost. The statement covers carrier-neutral facilities only. [GAMTEL's service page says businesses and ISPs can rent space at any of its 43 sites to co-locate servers and networking hardware](<https://gamtel.gm/co-location-facility-rental-services/>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found states that a data centre for hire in The Gambia is Tier III or above. Establishing would need one data centre for hire at Tier III or above.

In August 2025 [btw.media said GITGE rents colocation at its landing stations and data centres](<https://btw.media/en/gitge-drives-fibre-optic-growth-in-equatorial-guinea>) in Malabo and Bata. [GITGE's own presentation lists its Sipopo datacentre as colocation and carrier-neutral, in service](<https://gitge.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/07/PRESENTACION-6.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found states that a data centre for hire in Equatorial Guinea is Tier III or above, and no global cloud region has been found. Establishing would need one data centre for hire at Tier III or above.

In July 2025 [the state's Konza authority described its National Data Center as Tier III certified](<https://konza.go.ke/konza-cloud-partners/>). It sells cloud, hosting and colocation to government and private firms. [Africa Data Centres says its NBO1 Nairobi facility has four data halls certified Tier III](<https://www.africadatacentres.com/nairobi/>). In the last twelve months, [CIO Africa reported in September 2026 that iXAfrica's Nairobi campus hosts Oracle's Kenya public cloud region](<https://cioafrica.co/tcs-sovereign-cloud-goes-live-in-nairobi/>). A July 2024 statement that Kenya had no hyperscale cloud predates the Oracle region reported in September 2026.

[The Cable Consortium of Liberia offers co-location in its Monrovia landing facility](<https://ccliberia.com/co-location-services/>), in racks of 2U to 42U with UPS and generator power. [LTC Mobile's National Data Centre](<https://mopt.gov.lr/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/2026-Liberia-Data-Governance-Policy-REVISED-CIPESA-1.pdf>) and [Telecel Liberia's data centre](<https://telecelgroup.com/about-us/>) are listed as carrier-neutral colocation facilities in service. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found states that a data centre for hire in Liberia is Tier III or above, and no global cloud region has been found. Establishing would need one data centre for hire at Tier III or above.

In 2023 [the Misrata Free Zone opened a data hosting centre](<https://libyaherald.com/2023/02/misrata-free-zone-launches-data-hosting-centre-to-provide-quantum-leap-in-investor-services>), renting racks and storage to investors. In 2024 [Libyan Spider opened a data centre in Tripoli](<https://libyanspider.com/libyan-spider-opens-new-data-center-in-tripoli-to-enhance-security-and-availability/>). [The TransSahara Tripoli Data Center sells colocation](<https://libyaherald.com/2019/11/libyas-trans-sahara-and-moroccos-data-protect-sign-agreement-to-establish-first-data-security-operations-centre-in-libya/>), and its operator says it is Tier III or above. In August 2024 Al Sabaah said [the Libyan International Telecommunications Company's data centres had Uptime Institute Tier III certification](<https://alsabaah.ly/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B4%D8%B1%D9%83%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%84%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AA%D8%B5%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A7%D8%AA/>). They are not said to rent space to others. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Operating would need two or more data centres for hire at Tier III or above.

[Vodacom Lesotho's business page offers colocation in purpose-built data centres across the country](<https://www.vodacom.co.ls/business/fixed-solutions/>). It says its One Connect service is hosted in its two data centres at Maseru West and Lekokoaneng. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found states that a data centre for hire in Lesotho is Tier III or above, and no global cloud region has been found. Establishing would need one data centre for hire at Tier III or above.

Orange Maroc says [its Casablanca data centre meets Tier III design and facility standards](<https://telquel.ma/2025/02/14/cloud-souverain-orange-maroc-sallie-a-amazon-web-services_1918035>), and it hosts the AWS Wavelength zone. [DXC Technology Morocco holds Uptime Institute Tier III certification for its built data centre](<https://www.forcinews.com/dxc-technology-morocco-obtient-certification-tccf-tier-iii-par-luptime-institute/>), which serves customers. In 2025 [Global Finance counted 23 data centres in Morocco](<https://gfmag.com/emerging-frontier-markets/morocco-boom-in-data-centers/>). In the last twelve months, [Oracle's public cloud region in Casablanca was announced as running on 7 April 2026](<https://www.datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/oracle-launches-cloud-region-in-casablanca-morocco/>). Oracle calls it the first hyperscaler region in North Africa, and [it is preparing a second region at Settat](<https://aujourdhui.ma/economie/data-centers-avec-quelle-electricite>).

In 2024 [Xalam Analytics estimated that Madagascar had about 2 live commercial data centre facilities](<https://cms.d4dhub.eu/assets/Initiatives/Data-Governance-in-Africa/Digital-Investment-Facility/2507_Country-Market-Briefs/Data-Center-Market-Brief-Madagascar.pdf>), with 1.4 MW of live critical IT load and about 40% occupied. It names no facility. [STELLARIX offers colocation from two data centres in Antananarivo](<https://www.stellar-ix.com/solutions/colocation/housing/>), advertised at 99.982% availability. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found states that a data centre for hire in Madagascar is Tier III or above, and no global cloud region has been found. Establishing would need one data centre for hire at Tier III or above.

[The Malian government describes the National Data Centre in Bamako as a Tier III facility](<https://itweb.africa/article/mali-unveils-modern-tier-iii-data-centre/>), on its own word with no certification named. The ministry says it gives administrations, companies and start-ups a hosting environment. In 2022 [the ITU reported that the state company SMTD runs a government data centre offering colocation, IaaS and backup](<https://www.itu.int/dms_pub/itu-d/opb/pref/D-PREF-THEM.29-2022-PDF-F.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [SMTD-SA said in 2026 that it runs a public cloud with a self-service portal from Bamako](<https://www.malipages.com/appel-offre/recrutement-dun-cabinet-detudes-informatiques/>). A second data centre for hire at Tier III or above has not been found. Operating would need two or more data centres for hire at Tier III or above.

In December 2024 [Raxio said its Mozambique data centre had gained the Uptime Institute's Tier III certificate](<https://clubofmozambique.com/news/raxio-groups-mozambique-and-ethiopia-data-centres-achieve-uptime-institute-tier-iii-facility-certification/>). On 28 March 2025 [Vodacom Mozambique inaugurated its Vodacom Business data centre in Matola](<https://intic.gov.mz/intic-realiza-visita-de-trabalho-a-data-center-business-da-vodacom/>). The regulator INTIC says it is certified Tier III. No change has been found in the last twelve months. [The US Commercial Service states that AWS, Heroku and Azure sell cloud services to Mozambique](<https://www.trade.gov/market-intelligence/mozambiques-digital-transformation>). It says none of them runs its own data centre in the country. Mature would need a global cloud provider to sell its services from a cloud region in the country.

On 8 May 2025 [the President inaugurated the Nouakchott Data Centre, a state facility of 1,372 sq m and 100 racks](<https://ami.mr/fr/archives/270548>). The state news agency AMI says it holds a Level 3 (Tier III) certification, and that it offers in-country cloud hosting and backup to public administrations, financial institutions and startups. [The US Country Commercial Guide also states it is Tier III](<https://www.trade.gov/country-commercial-guides/mauritania-digital-economy>), with no certifier named. No change has been found in the last twelve months. A second data centre for hire at Tier III or above has not been found. Operating would need two or more data centres for hire at Tier III or above.

A 2025 Telecom Review Africa feature names [two operating data centres at Tier III or IV](<https://www.telecomreviewafrica.com/articles/features/12397-sublime-seas-to-storage-sphere-mauritius-expands-hyperscale-data-hub/>). Harel Mallac Technologies in Port Louis is Tier III, and Bhumishq is designed to Tier IV. [Mauritius Telecom's chief executive says the operator has a Tier IV data centre](<https://lexpress.mu/node/554669>). In 2025 TechReviewAfrica said [its Rose Belle centre offers hosting, disaster recovery and business continuity](<https://techreviewafrica.com/news/3588/mauritius-itci-minister-tours-mauritius-telecoms-tier-iv-data-centre-in-rose-belle>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No global cloud region has been found. Mature would need a global cloud provider to sell its services from a cloud region in the country.

[TNM states it acquired OpenConnect Limited's Tier 3 data centre at Kanengo, Lilongwe, for K12 billion](<https://www.itweb.africa/article/tnm-expands-malawi-data-infrastructure/mYZRXM9gbA6vOgA8>). The tier is stated by the company, with no certification named. In the last twelve months, [Sparc Systems unveiled in 2026 its new Lilongwe data centre, with capacity for up to 120 racks](<https://www.malawivoice.com/2026/05/01/sparc-systems-expands-malawis-digital-infrastructure-with-new-data-centre/>), to provide data hosting for institutions. A second data centre for hire at Tier III or above has not been found, and no global cloud region. Operating would need two or more data centres for hire at Tier III or above.

[Paratus states that the carrier-neutral Armada Data Center in Windhoek is Tier-III by design](<https://paratus.africa/docs/Paratus-Annual-Report-2025-online.pdf>), with no Uptime Institute certification named. In the last twelve months it was cited and not changed: [The Villager reported on 14 August 2026 that Armada already exists and provides local data centre and hosting services](<https://www.thevillager.com.na/national/2026/pressure-mounting-for-namibia-to-build-own-digital-infrastructure/>). The government's national data centre is only planned. No second data centre for hire at Tier III or above has been found, and no global cloud region. Operating would need two or more data centres for hire at Tier III or above.

In July 2026 Nigeria had [about 26 data centres, 18 of them commercial](<https://www.zawya.com/en/economy/africa/nigeria-tests-data-sovereignty-tfwnm5he>). The state-owned Galaxy Backbone [holds Uptime Institute Tier III certification for its Abuja centre](<https://galaxybackbone.com.ng/galaxy-backbone-limited-national-shared-service-dc1-ph1-abuja-achieves-uptime-institute-tier-iii-certification-of-constructed-facility/>) and sells hosting. MTN Nigeria's Dabengwa centre in Lagos [received Uptime Institute Tier III certification in September 2025](<https://www.techbooky.com/mtn-secures-tier-iii-certification-for-data-centre/>).
